summary: SVG funnel chart: one centered bar per stage, proportional to the first, with value and conversion rate, keyboard navigation, and an accessible data table.
whenToUse: Showing how many people or how much value moves from one stage of a process to the next (purchase, sign-up, sales pipeline).
Spotting the stage with the biggest drop-off.
whenNotToUse: Categories without a process order: use BarChart.
Parts of a total: use DonutChart.

props.name: data
props.description: Stages from top to bottom; the first is 100% conversion. Negative values count as 0.

props.name: title
props.description: Visible title (figcaption); names the chart and the data table.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Format of the values in the current locale; conversions always use Intl with style percent.

props.name: height
props.description: Height in px of each stage (minimum 16).

props.name: appearance
props.description: Visual style: vivid uses gradients, rounded corners, and colored connectors; auto becomes vivid in the expressive look.

inherits: HTML attributes of <figure> (id, style, data-*, aria-*…); the ref points to the <figure>.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the chart area, then to the table button.
Next/previous stage: highlights the stage and announces its label, value, and conversion.

accessibility: <figure> with <figcaption>; focusable role="group" area with a hint and aria-live="polite" announcements.
Labels, values, and conversions are written next to each bar: color isn't needed to read the chart.
Data table with "Value" and "Conversion" columns (share of the first stage).
In forced-colors mode, bars become Canvas with a CanvasText border; the active stage has a Highlight border.
responsive: Width measured with ResizeObserver: label and value columns take at most 30% each; long labels are truncated (full text in the active readout and the table).
Entry animation only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
customization: Vivid appearance: appearance="vivid" (or the expressive look) paints the bars with gradients between --dc-color-data-N and --dc-color-accent-default; it falls back to flat in forced-colors mode.
commonMistakes: Unordered or non-sequential stages: conversion is always calculated against the first stage.
Using increasing values: the funnel loses its meaning; use BarChart.

examples.name: Vivid
examples.title: Vivid appearance
examples.description: Gradients and colored connectors with the theme colors.

limits: Conversion is relative to the first stage only (not between consecutive stages).
If a stage exceeds the first, widths are scaled to the maximum value.
On very narrow screens, labels and values take up to 60% of the width.
